intro: GuanTing 12 V brick + its screw-terminal socket tip (rough stand-ins, the tip is the small part at the right). Prongs point toward you at -Y; the outer (label) face is at +Y; Z up, cord out the bottom. Type what you measure; leave a box empty if you can't get at it, and put shape notes (flat vs rounded, grooves vs raised ribs, both sides?) in the box after the number.

measurements.label: Cord OD
measurements.how: Calipers across the round cord a few cm below the brick, light squeeze.

measurements.label: Cord boot OD at the brick
measurements.how: The rubber strain-relief where the cord leaves the bottom: widest point. If there is no boot, write 0.

measurements.label: Cord boot length
measurements.how: From the brick's bottom face down to where the boot ends and the plain cord starts.

measurements.label: Green screw block length along the tip
measurements.how: On the socket tip: length of the green block measured along the tip's axis (barrel-to-screws direction).

measurements.label: Prong block width
measurements.how: Across the raised block the prongs stand on, side to side. If it is narrower than the body, also note how far it sits in from each side.

measurements.label: Prong block side corner radius
measurements.how: Look down at the top: is the prong block's outer corner sharp (0), rounded (radius) or chamfered? Note which.

measurements.label: Front-view corner radius
measurements.how: Looking straight at the label face: radius of the corners of the 45 x 85 outline. A coin of known size held in the corner helps.

measurements.label: Top curve: height on the label face
measurements.how: Side view. From the top edge down the label face to where it stops curving and goes flat (your T).

measurements.label: Top curve: depth along the top
measurements.how: Side view. Lay a ruler on the top face; from where the top stops being flat to the label-face plane. Same as the height above = quarter circle; note if it looks more like a chamfer.

measurements.label: Bottom curve: height on the label face
measurements.how: Same as the top, at the bottom end.

measurements.label: Bottom curve: depth along the bottom
measurements.how: Same as the top, along the bottom face.

measurements.label: Vent ribs: lowest rib from the bottom
measurements.how: On the side faces: bottom edge of the brick up to the lowest rib/slot. Note if there are ribs on both sides or also elsewhere.

measurements.label: Vent ribs: highest rib from the bottom
measurements.how: Bottom edge up to the top of the highest rib/slot.

measurements.label: Vent ribs: depth
measurements.how: How deep the grooves go, or how far the ribs stand out from the side. Note grooves or raised.

measurements.label: Vent ribs: from the main back face
measurements.how: Along the side, from the main back face (the one below the prong block) to where the ribs start. The snap lips sit right here.

measurements.label: Prong spacing, centre to centre
measurements.how: Between the middles of the two blades.

measurements.label: Prong length
measurements.how: From the prong block face out to the blade tip.

measurements.label: Prong blade height
measurements.how: Blade width in the up-down direction. Note if one blade is wider (polarized).

measurements.label: Left side to prong pair middle
measurements.how: From the brick's left side (seen from the prong side) to the midpoint between the blades: tells if the prongs are centred.
